quote: Each man should frame life so that at some future hour fact and his dreaming meet.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: Dreams are true while they last, and do we not live in dreams?
author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

quote: In dreams begins responsibility.
author: William Butler Yeats

quote: I am accustomed to sleep and in my dreams to imagine the same things that lunatics imagine when awake.
author: Rene Descartes

quote: Without leaps of imagination, or dreaming, we lose the excitement of possibilities. Dreaming, after all, is a form of planning.
author: Gloria Steinem

quote: So many of our dreams at first seem impossible, then they seem improbable, and then, when we summon the will, they soon become inevitable.
author: Christopher Reeve

quote: Living in dreams of yesterday, we find ourselves still dreaming of impossible future conquests.
author: Charles Lindbergh

quote: I've always said that one night, I'm going to find myself in some field somewhere, I'm standing on grass, and it's raining, and I'm with the person I love, and I know I'm at the very point I've been dreaming of getting to.
author: Drew Barrymore

quote: The world needs dreamers and the world needs doers. But above all, the world needs dreamers who do.
author: Sarah Ban Breathnach

quote: No one should negotiate their dreams. Dreams must be free to fly high. No government, no legislature, has a right to limit your dreams. You should never agree to surrender your dreams.
author: Jesse Jackson

quote: Sometimes, the only realists are the dreamers.
author: Paul Wellstone

quote: Ideologies separate us. Dreams and anguish bring us together.
author: Eugene Ionesco

quote: I think we dream so we don't have to be apart so long. If we're in each other's dreams, we can play together all night.
author: Bill Watterson

quote: When you cease to dream you cease to live.
author: Malcolm Forbes

quote: Only in our dreams are we free. The rest of the time we need wages.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: All the things one has forgotten scream for help in dreams.
author: Elias Canetti

quote: Dreaming or awake, we perceive only events that have meaning to us.
author: Jane Roberts

quote: I do not know whether I was then a man dreaming I was a butterfly, or whether I am now a butterfly dreaming I am a man.
author: Zhuangzi

quote: A dream you dream alone is only a dream. A dream you dream together is reality.
author: Yoko Ono

quote: All men of action are dreamers.
author: James Huneker

quote: I stand for freedom of expression, doing what you believe in, and going after your dreams.
author: Madonna Ciccone

quote: Like all dreamers, I mistook disenchantment for truth.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: The dreamer can know no truth, not even about his dream, except by awaking out of it.
author: George Santayana

quote: Those who have compared our life to a dream were right... we were sleeping wake, and waking sleep.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: I am a dreamer. Seriously, I'm living on another planet.
author: Eva Green

quote: I have always been amazed at the way an ordinary observer lends so much more credence and attaches so much more importance to waking events than to those occurring in dreams... Man... is above all the plaything of his memory.
author: Andre Breton

quote: Perhaps life is just that... a dream and a fear.
author: Joseph Conrad

quote: I don't use drugs, my dreams are frightening enough.
author: M. C. Escher

quote: I tell people I'm too stupid to know what's impossible. I have ridiculously large dreams, and half the time they come true.
author: Debi Thomas

quote: Dreaming of a tomorrow, which tomorrow, will be as distant then as 'tis today.
author: Lope de Vega

quote: Dreams will get you nowhere, a good kick in the pants will take you a long way.
author: Baltasar Gracian

quote: Dreaming men are haunted men.
author: Stephen Vincent Benet

quote: My dreams were all my own I accounted for them to nobody they were my refuge when annoyed - my dearest pleasure when free.
author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley

quote: Man is a genius when he is dreaming.
author: Akira Kurosawa

quote: The world of men is dreaming, it has gone mad in its sleep, and a snake is strangling it, but it can't wake up.
author: David Herbert Lawrence

quote: We are near waking when we dream we are dreaming.
author: Novalis

quote: You have to have a dream so you can get up in the morning.
author: Billy Wilder

quote: Was it only by dreaming or writing that I could find out what I thought?
author: Joan Didion

quote: I was always a dreamer, in childhood especially. People thought I was a little strange.
author: Charley Pride

quote: People are so busy dreaming the American Dream, fantasizing about what they could be or have a right to be, that they're all asleep at the switch. Consequently we are living in the Age of Human Error.
author: Florence King

quote: This is the city of dreamers and time and again it's the place where the greatest dream of all, the American dream, has been tested and has triumphed.
author: Michael Bloomberg

quote: Only the dreamer shall understand realities, though in truth his dreaming must be not out of proportion to his waking.
author: Margaret Fuller

quote: One of the most adventurous things left us is to go to bed. For no one can lay a hand on our dreams.
author: E. V. Lucas

quote: We all keep dreaming, and luckily, dreams come true.
author: Katie Holmes

quote: You know, Willie Wonka said it best: we are the makers of dreams, the dreamers of dreams.
author: Herb Brooks

quote: Married or unmarried, young or old, poet or worker, you are still a dreamer, and will one time know, and feel, that your life is but a dream.
author: Donald G. Mitchell

quote: I challenge you to be dreamers I challenge you to be doers and let us make the greatest place in the world even better.
author: Brian Schweitzer

quote: The interpretation of dreams is a great art.
author: Paracelsus

quote: Everybody's a dreamer.
author: John Lithgow

quote: People need dreams, there's as much nourishment in 'em as food.
author: Dorothy Gilman

quote: That's what keeps me going: dreaming, inventing, then hoping and dreaming some more in order to keep dreaming.
author: Joseph Barbera

quote: You can plant a dream.
author: Anne Campbell

quote: Writers write. Dreamers talk about it.
author: Jerry B. Jenkins

quote: Oh, I was never a businessman. I was a visionary, a dreamer.
author: Jim Bakker

quote: Take everything easy and quit dreaming and brooding and you will be well guarded from a thousand evils.
author: Amy Lowell

quote: Strivers achieve what dreamers believe.
author: Usher

quote: We should never discourage young people from dreaming dreams.
author: Lenny Wilkens

quote: Only things the dreamers make live on. They are the eternal conquerors.
author: Herbert Kaufman

quote: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: I believe in everything until it's disproved. So I believe in fairies, the myths, dragons. It all exists, even if it's in your mind. Who's to say that dreams and nightmares aren't as real as the here and now?
author: John Lennon

quote: Life is full of beauty. Notice it. Notice the bumble bee, the small child, and the smiling faces. Smell the rain, and feel the wind. Live your life to the fullest potential, and fight for your dreams.
author: Ashley Smith

quote: Follow your dreams, work hard, practice and persevere. Make sure you eat a variety of foods, get plenty of exercise and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
author: Sasha Cohen

quote: I like the dreams of the future better than the history of the past.
author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: Cherish your visions and your dreams as they are the children of your soul, the blueprints of your ultimate achievements.
author: Napoleon Hill

quote: Your vision will become clear only when you can look into your own heart. Who looks outside, dreams who looks inside, awakes.
author: Carl Jung

quote: Friends... they cherish one another's hopes. They are kind to one another's dreams.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
author: Robert Fulghum

quote: I prefer to be a dreamer among the humblest, with visions to be realized, than lord among those without dreams and desires.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: But I, being poor, have only my dreams I have spread my dreams under your feet Tread softly because you tread on my dreams.
author: William Butler Yeats

quote: The only thing that comes to a sleeping man is dreams.
author: Tupac Shakur

quote: I have learned, that if one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life he has imagined, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: Trust in dreams, for in them is hidden the gate to eternity.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Consult not your fears but your hopes and your dreams. Think not about your frustrations, but about your unfulfilled potential. Concern yourself not with what you tried and failed in, but with what it is still possible for you to do.
author: Pope John XXIII

quote: The only time you really live fully is from thirty to sixty. The young are slaves to dreams the old servants of regrets. Only the middle-aged have all their five senses in the keeping of their wits.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: Our truest life is when we are in dreams awake.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: If there are dreams about a beautiful South Africa, there are also roads that lead to their goal. Two of these roads could be named Goodness and Forgiveness.
author: Nelson Mandela

quote: The ninety and nine are with dreams, content but the hope of the world made new, is the hundredth man who is grimly bent on making those dreams come true.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
author: Oprah Winfrey

quote: If one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life which he has imagined, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: I'll let you be in my dreams if I can be in yours.
author: Bob Dylan

quote: I am against nature. I don't dig nature at all. I think nature is very unnatural. I think the truly natural things are dreams, which nature can't touch with decay.
author: Bob Dylan

quote: It is better to risk starving to death then surrender. If you give up on your dreams, what's left?
author: Jim Carrey

quote: Dreams are often most profound when they seem the most crazy.
author: Sigmund Freud

quote: I really had a lot of dreams when I was a kid, and I think a great deal of that grew out of the fact that I had a chance to read a lot.
author: Bill Gates

quote: Keep true to the dreams of your youth.
author: Friedrich Schiller

quote: Hold fast to dreams, for if dreams die, life is a broken-winged bird that cannot fly.
author: Langston Hughes

quote: Sometimes dreams are wiser than waking.
author: Black Elk

quote: Why does the eye see a thing more clearly in dreams than the imagination when awake?
author: Leonardo da Vinci

quote: Believe in love. Believe in magic. Hell, believe in Santa Clause. Believe in others. Believe in yourself. Believe in your dreams. If you don't, who will?
author: Jon Bon Jovi

quote: Tread softly because you tread on my dreams.
author: William Butler Yeats

quote: We cast away priceless time in dreams, born of imagination, fed upon illusion, and put to death by reality.
author: Judy Garland

quote: Man, alone, has the power to transform his thoughts into physical reality man, alone, can dream and make his dreams come true.
author: Napoleon Hill

quote: Our life is composed greatly from dreams, from the unconscious, and they must be brought into connection with action. They must be woven together.
author: Anais Nin

quote: Dreams must be heeded and accepted. For a great many of them come true.
author: Paracelsus

quote: Business and growing jobs is about taking risk, sometimes failing, sometimes succeeding, but always striving. It is about dreams. Usually, it doesn't work out exactly as you might have imagined. Steve Jobs was fired at Apple. He came back and changed the world.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: Just what future the Designer of the universe has provided for the souls of men I do not know, I cannot prove. But I find that the whole order of Nature confirms my confidence that, if it is not like our noblest hopes and dreams, it will transcend them.
author: Henry Norris Russell

quote: I'd say it's been my biggest problem all my life... it's money. It takes a lot of money to make these dreams come true.
author: Walt Disney

quote: Keep your dreams alive. Understand to achieve anything requires faith and belief in yourself, vision, hard work, determination, and dedication. Remember all things are possible for those who believe.
author: Gail Devers

quote: Don't give up on your dreams, or your dreams will give up on you.
author: John Wooden

quote: If you dream the proper dreams, and share the myths with people, they will want to grow up to be like you.
author: Ray Bradbury

quote: Computers are magnificent tools for the realization of our dreams, but no machine can replace the human spark of spirit, compassion, love, and understanding.
author: Louis Gerstner

quote: Both dreams and myths are important communications from ourselves to ourselves. If we do not understand the language in which they are written, we miss a great deal of what we know and tell ourselves in those hours when we are not busy manipulating the outside world.
author: Erich Fromm

quote: Dreams do come true, if we only wish hard enough, You can have anything in life if you will sacrifice everything else for it.
author: James M. Barrie

quote: The greatest achievement was at first and for a time a dream. The oak sleeps in the acorn, the bird waits in the egg, and in the highest vision of the soul a waking angel stirs. Dreams are the seedlings of realities.
author: James Allen

quote: High achievers spot rich opportunities swiftly, make big decisions quickly and move into action immediately. Follow these principles and you can make your dreams come true.
author: Robert H. Schuller

quote: How blessed are some people, whose lives have no fears, no dreads to whom sleep is a blessing that comes nightly, and brings nothing but sweet dreams.
author: Bram Stoker

quote: Never underestimate the power of dreams and the influence of the human spirit. We are all the same in this notion: The potential for greatness lives within each of us.
author: Wilma Rudolph

quote: You know, my dad served in the President's Cabinet after his time as a governor. He told me he enjoyed being governor a lot more. Now, I understand why. If I do my job well, I can make a difference in people's lives and I can help our children realize their dreams.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: When all of your wishes are granted, many of your dreams will be destroyed.
author: Marilyn Manson

quote: Help others achieve their dreams and you will achieve yours.
author: Les Brown

quote: It is not true that people stop pursuing dreams because they grow old, they grow old because they stop pursuing dreams.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

quote: In my dreams I hear again the crash of guns, the rattle of musketry, the strange, mournful mutter of the battlefield.
author: Douglas MacArthur

quote: Anyone who has lost track of time when using a computer knows the propensity to dream, the urge to make dreams come true and the tendency to miss lunch.
author: Tim Berners-Lee

quote: What is a television apparatus to man, who has only to shut his eyes to see the most inaccessible regions of the seen and the never seen, who has only to imagine in order to pierce through walls and cause all the planetary Baghdads of his dreams to rise from the dust.
author: Salvador Dali

quote: Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.
author: Les Brown

quote: Our life dreams the Utopia. Our death achieves the Ideal.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: I have dreamed in my life, dreams that have stayed with me ever after, and changed my ideas they have gone through and through me, like wine through water, and altered the color of my mind.
author: Emily Bronte

quote: Obviously one must hold oneself responsible for the evil impulses of one's dreams. In what other way can one deal with them? Unless the content of the dream rightly understood is inspired by alien spirits, it is part of my own being.
author: Sigmund Freud

quote: Old age realizes the dreams of youth: look at Dean Swift in his youth he built an asylum for the insane, in his old age he was himself an inmate.
author: Soren Kierkegaard

quote: No matter how carefully you plan your goals they will never be more than pipe dreams unless you pursue them with gusto.
author: W. Clement Stone

quote: I never ask a man what his business is, for it never interests me. What I ask him about are his thoughts and dreams.
author: H. P. Lovecraft

quote: Dream lofty dreams, and as you dream, so you shall become. Your vision is the promise of what you shall one day be your ideal is the prophecy of what you shall at last unveil.
author: James Allen

quote: If you can't read, it's going to be hard to realize dreams.
author: Booker T. Washington

quote: Follow your dreams, believe in yourself and don't give up.
author: Rachel Corrie

quote: Never let life impede on your ability to manifest your dreams. Dig deeper into your dreams and deeper into yourself and believe that anything is possible, and make it happen.
author: Corin Nemec

quote: I never paint dreams or nightmares. I paint my own reality.
author: Frida Kahlo

quote: The life of a man consists not in seeing visions and in dreaming dreams, but in active charity and in willing service.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quote: You know, the man of my dreams might walk round the corner tomorrow. I'm older and wiser and I think I'd make a great girlfriend. I live in the realm of romantic possibility.
author: Stevie Nicks

quote: I am a walking piece of art every day, with my dreams and my ambitions forward at all times in an effort to inspire my fans to lead their life in that way.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: A lot of people do not muster the courage to live their dreams because they are afraid to die.
author: Les Brown

quote: You have all the reason in the world to achieve your grandest dreams. Imagination plus innovation equals realization.
author: Denis Waitley

quote: We become not a melting pot but a beautiful mosaic. Different people, different beliefs, different yearnings, different hopes, different dreams.
author: Jimmy Carter

quote: What is life? A madness. What is life? An illusion, a shadow, a story. And the greatest good is little enough for all life is a dream, and dreams themselves are only dreams.
author: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

quote: You have many years ahead of you to create the dreams that we can't even imagine dreaming. You have done more for the collective unconscious of this planet than you will ever know.
author: Steven Spielberg

quote: The success I have achieved in bodybuilding, motion pictures, and business would not have been possible without the generosity of the American people and the freedom here to pursue your dreams.
author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

quote: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
author: J. K. Rowling

quote: Ocean is more ancient than the mountains, and freighted with the memories and the dreams of Time.
author: H. P. Lovecraft

quote: Dreams are illustrations... from the book your soul is writing about you.
author: Marsha Norman

quote: There's nothing as exciting as a comeback - seeing someone with dreams, watching them fail, and then getting a second chance.
author: Rachel Griffiths

quote: Lose your dreams and you might lose your mind.
author: Mick Jagger

quote: Take, if you must, this little bag of dreams, Unloose the cord, and they will wrap you round.
author: William Butler Yeats

quote: It's insecurity that is always chasing you and standing in the way of your dreams.
author: Vin Diesel

quote: A positive attitude can really make dreams come true - it did for me.
author: David Bailey

quote: My own dreams fortunately came true in this great state. I became Mr. Universe I became a successful businessman. And even though some people say I still speak with a slight accent, I have reached the top of the acting profession.
author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

quote: I'm not just a boy toy. I have feelings and dreams like anybody else.
author: Jon Stewart

quote: The world is seldom what it seems to man, who dimly sees, realities appear as dreams, and dreams realities.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: Most new jobs won't come from our biggest employers. They will come from our smallest. We've got to do everything we can to make entrepreneurial dreams a reality.
author: Ross Perot

quote: When the legends die, the dreams end there is no more greatness.
author: Tecumseh

quote: I tell kids to pursue their basketball dreams, but I tell them to not let that be their only dream.
author: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

quote: Flying dreams mean that you're doing the right thing with your life.
author: Doug Coupland

quote: Common sense tells us that the things of the earth exist only a little, and that true reality is only in dreams.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: My parent's divorce and hard times at school, all those things combined to mold me, to make me grow up quicker. And it gave me the drive to pursue my dreams that I wouldn't necessarily have had otherwise.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: It is in our idleness, in our dreams, that the submerged truth sometimes comes to the top.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: The way to kill a man or a nation is to cut off his dreams, the way the whites are taking care of the Indians: killing their dreams, their magic, their familiar spirits.
author: William S. Burroughs

quote: But are not the dreams of poets and the tales of travellers notoriously false?
author: H. P. Lovecraft

quote: There are many talented people who haven't fulfilled their dreams because they over thought it, or they were too cautious, and were unwilling to make the leap of faith.
author: James Cameron

quote: An athlete cannot run with money in his pockets. He must run with hope in his heart and dreams in his head.
author: Emil Zatopek

quote: The work goes on, the cause endures, the hope still lives and the dreams shall never die.
author: Edward Kennedy

quote: I want my boys to have an understanding of people's emotions, their insecurities, people's distress, and their hopes and dreams.
author: Princess Diana

quote: There are a lot of things that are personally uncomfortable to show, especially me without makeup and completely bloated or crying. But I've realized that it's time for me to show my audience that you don't have to be perfect to achieve your dreams. Because nobody relates to being perfect.
author: Katy Perry

quote: For all life is a dream, and dreams themselves are only dreams.
author: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

quote: A horse is the projection of peoples' dreams about themselves - strong, powerful, beautiful - and it has the capability of giving us escape from our mundane existence.
author: Pam Brown

quote: Follow your dreams. Just make sure to have fun too.
author: Chris Brown

quote: We must look for ways to be an active force in our own lives. We must take charge of our own destinies, design a life of substance and truly begin to live our dreams.
author: Les Brown

quote: Lonesome. Lonesome. I know what it means. Here all by my lonesome, dreaming empty dreams. Weary. Weary at the close of day, wondering if tomorrow brings me joy or sorrow.
author: Leon Redbone

quote: To the degree we're not living our dreams, our comfort zone has more control of us than we have over ourselves.
author: Peter McWilliams

quote: Dream small dreams. If you make them too big, you get overwhelmed and you don't do anything. If you make small goals and accomplish them, it gives you the confidence to go on to higher goals.
author: John H. Johnson

quote: Yet it is in our idleness, in our dreams, that the submerged truth sometimes comes to the top.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: It takes someone with a vision of the possibilities to attain new levels of experience. Someone with the courage to live his dreams.
author: Les Brown

quote: Our dreams must be stronger than our memories. We must be pulled by our dreams, rater than pushed by our memories.
author: Jesse Jackson

quote: The human heart has hidden treasures, In secret kept, in silence sealed The thoughts, the hopes, the dreams, the pleasures, Whose charms were broken if revealed.
author: Charlotte Bronte

quote: I can never decide whether my dreams are the result of my thoughts, or my thoughts the result of my dreams.
author: David Herbert Lawrence

quote: A test of what is real is that it is hard and rough. Joys are found in it, not pleasure. What is pleasant belongs to dreams.
author: Simone Weil

quote: Though we may have desires or bold goals, for whatever reason, most of us don't think we can achieve something beyond what we're qualified to achieve. Why, I ask, do we let reality interfere with our dreams?
author: Simon Sinek

quote: Dreams are not without meaning wherever thay may come from-from fantasy, from the elements, or from other inspiration.
author: Paracelsus

quote: I just write what I wanted to write. I write what amuses me. It's totally for myself. I never in my wildest dreams expected this popularity.
author: J. K. Rowling

quote: All of us gave it all we've got, overcame a whole lot just being on the show and learned a lot about ourselves. We're just normal people trying to do what we love and follow our dreams.
author: Carrie Underwood

quote: Freedom and democracy are dreams you never give up.
author: Aung San Suu Kyi

quote: My fear is that I go up to the girl of my dreams and say 'I'm sorry, but I've got to say hello to you,' and she slides the stool back and gets up and walks away, saying, 'Not for me, Bub. I don't want anything to do with you.'
author: John Mayer

quote: People are never more insecure than when they become obsessed with their fears at the expense of their dreams.
author: Norman Cousins

quote: Much can be inferred about a man from his mistress: in her one beholds his weaknesses and his dreams.
author: Georg C. Lichtenberg

quote: Dreams can become a reality when we possess a vision that is characterized by the willingness to work hard, a desire for excellence, and a belief in our right and our responsiblity to be equal members of society.
author: Janet Jackson

quote: I just kind of wake up with a new idea and new dreams every day, and I follow that dream, as they say.
author: Dolly Parton

quote: I did commit to myself that I would not jump back into being the workaholic that I can be before I gave myself an honest opportunity to create the marriage of my dreams and to create the beginning of the family of my dreams, and that took a hot second.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: We do not really feel grateful toward those who make our dreams come true they ruin our dreams.
author: Eric Hoffer

quote: In dreams the truth is learned that all good works are done in the absence of a caress.
author: Leonard Cohen

quote: You must recognize, embrace, and be honest about what is real for you today and allow that understanding to inform the choices you make. Only then will you be able to build the future of your dreams.
author: Suze Orman

quote: I'm aware of the mystery around us, so I write about coincidences, premonitions, emotions, dreams, the power of nature, magic.
author: Isabel Allende

quote: Dreams are like paper, they tear so easily.
author: Gilda Radner

quote: When we see the face of a child, we think of the future. We think of their dreams about what they might become, and what they might accomplish.
author: Desmond Tutu

quote: I don't design clothes, I design dreams.
author: Ralph Lauren

quote: Everybody past a certain age, regardless of how they look on the outside, pretty much constantly dreams of being able to escape from their lives.
author: Doug Coupland

quote: It is one of the blessings of this world that few people see visions and dream dreams.
author: Zora Neale Hurston

quote: Rude contact with facts chased my visions and dreams quickly away, and in their stead I beheld the horrors, the corruption, the evils and hypocrisy of society, and as I stood among them, a young wife, a great wail of agony went out from my soul.
author: Victoria Woodhull

quote: Stay focused, go after your dreams and keep moving toward your goals.
author: LL Cool J

quote: To this day, some of my closest friends say, 'Gaga, you know, everything's great. You're a singer your dreams have come true.' But, still, when certain things are said to you over and over again as you're growing up, it stays with you and you wonder if they're true.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: Dreams don't have deadlines. I'm thinking of doing bigger and better things and having more fun with it.
author: LL Cool J

quote: To every people the land is given on condition. Perceived or not, there is a Covenant, beyond the constitution, beyond sovereign guarantee, beyond the nation's sweetest dreams of itself.
author: Leonard Cohen

quote: There's a joy and a pain about directing where the dreams you have are becoming concrete but the attention to detail, the need for time is such that it's overwhelming at times, and the stream of responsibility.
author: William Shatner

quote: Hope lies in dreams, in imagination, and in the courage of those who dare to make dreams into reality.
author: Jonas Salk

quote: Dreams are real as long as they last. Can we say more of life?
author: Havelock Ellis

quote: Take pleasure in your dreams relish your principles and drape your purest feelings on the heart of a precious lover.
author: Giotto di Bondone

quote: To be given the opportunity to help shape new artists' careers and mentor them to see their dreams come to fruition is a task I welcome with open arms.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: I know how men in exile feed on dreams.
author: Aeschylus

quote: A friend told me that teenage girls are always looking for someone to pin their dreams on. That doesn't make it any less weird though.
author: Orlando Bloom

quote: To all, to each, a fair good-night, and pleasing dreams, and slumbers light.
author: Walter Scott

quote: A runner must run with dreams in his heart, not money in his pocket.
author: Emil Zatopek

quote: I have had dreams and I have had nightmares, but I have conquered my nightmares because of my dreams.
author: Jonas Salk

quote: We should be dreaming. We grew up as kids having dreams, but now we're too sophisticated as adults, as a nation. We stopped dreaming. We should always have dreams.
author: Herb Brooks

quote: But what I was going to say was, I just figured I'm going to go boldly in the direction of my dreams, say it as Thoreau would say, and just see where it takes me.
author: Demetri Martin

quote: At first, dreams seem impossible, then improbable, and eventually inevitable.
author: Christopher Reeve

quote: The follow your dreams thing is really important because so many people are railroaded into taking other paths by their family, their friends, people who should be supportive going, 'What are you talking about?' Even just seemingly regular career paths, but if it's not what people expect for you they kind of react funny.
author: Joan Jett

quote: I think when you're in a relationship where you really care for the other person, when they achieve their dreams it's better than when you do yourself.
author: Nicole Kidman

quote: For even in dreams a good deed is not lost.
author: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

quote: Whatever dreams I have wished have come true.
author: Annette Funicello

quote: No one may speak for the dead, no one may interpret their mutilated dreams and visions.
author: Elie Wiesel

quote: I'd definitely be the kind of parent who enabled my child's dreams. I'd just watch and nurture and guide them. I have the blueprints of what not to do... I think I'd be a good parent, actually.
author: Drew Barrymore

quote: Winners, I am convinced, imagine their dreams first. They want it with all their heart and expect it to come true. There is, I believe, no other way to live.
author: Joe Montana

quote: The real hero is always a hero by mistake he dreams of being an honest coward like everybody else.
author: Umberto Eco

quote: I am so excited to let fans in on how important my relationship with my family is to me. I hope to motivate mothers and daughters to build lifetimes of memories together and inspire kids around the world to live their dreams.
author: Miley Cyrus

quote: 'Do What You Gotta Do' is a positive, inspirational song that says no matter what it is whether you're up against challenges or trying to get your dreams and aspirations met, you should do what whatever you have to do shy of killing yourself or someone else.
author: Angie Stone

quote: A successful life is one that is lived through understanding and pursuing one's own path, not chasing after the dreams of others.
author: Chin-Ning Chu

quote: There are a lot of things that are personally uncomfortable to show, especially me without makeup and completely bloated or crying. But I've realized that it's time for me to show my audience that you don't have to be perfect to achieve your dreams.
author: Katy Perry

quote: She still talks to me now, only now she talks to me in my dreams. And I can't wait to go to sleep tonight because we have a lot to talk about. I love you.
author: Jamie Foxx

quote: Do It Under the Influence Yourself! That's what we're shooting for! Get drunk and make your dreams come true.
author: Aziz Ansari

quote: Life being what it is, one dreams of revenge.
author: Paul Gauguin

quote: I couldn't find the sports car of my dreams, so I built it myself.
author: Ferdinand Porsche

quote: Learn from your dreams what you lack.
author: W. H. Auden

quote: I've had quite a lot of luck with dreams. I've often awoken in the night with a phrase or even a whole song in my head.
author: Brian Eno

quote: I think there's a time as a writer when you want to see the best things in life, and you go out wherever you go with your dreams as a writer or a composer.
author: Tori Amos

quote: In my dreams, I could be a Princess, and that's what I was. Like most little girls, I believed nothing less than a Prince could make my dreams come true.
author: Loretta Young

quote: The curse of the romantic is a greed for dreams, an intensity of expectation that, in the end, diminishes the reality.
author: Marya Mannes

quote: Not all lucid dreams are useful but they all have a sense of wonder about them. If you must sleep through a third of your life, why should you sleep through your dreams, too?
author: Stephen LaBerge

quote: There's always going to be dreams and goals I have, but I never really tell people what they are.
author: Tyra Banks

quote: Intellectual despair results in neither weakness nor dreams, but in violence. It is only a matter of knowing how to give vent to one's rage whether one only wants to wander like madmen around prisons, or whether one wants to overturn them.
author: Georges Bataille

quote: Every comedian dreams of hosting 'The Tonight Show' and, for seven months, I got to. I did it my way, with people I love, and I do not regret a second.
author: Conan O'Brien

quote: Reality seems valueless by comparison with the dreams of fevered imaginations reality is therefore abandoned.
author: Emile Durkheim

quote: Without peace, all other dreams vanish and are reduced to ashes.
author: Jawaharlal Nehru

quote: People who insist on telling their dreams are among the terrors of the breakfast table.
author: Max Beerbohm

quote: We must stop talking about the American dream and start listening to the dreams of Americans.
author: Max Beerbohm

quote: Our dreams drench us in senses, and senses steps us again in dreams.
author: Amos Bronson Alcott

quote: My imagination completely controls me, and forever feeds the fire that burns with dark red light in my heart by bringing me the best dreams. I've always had a wild imagination, a big heart and a tortured soul so I feel that dark fantasy, love and horror are in my blood.
author: Kim Elizabeth

quote: Like dreams, statistics are a form of wish fulfillment.
author: Jean Baudrillard

quote: All art is exorcism. I paint dreams and visions too the dreams and visions of my time. Painting is the effort to produce order order in yourself. There is much chaos in me, much chaos in our time.
author: Otto Dix

quote: I have been interested in dreams, really since I was a kid. I have always been fascinated by the idea that your mind, when you are asleep, can create a world in a dream and you are perceiving it as though it really existed.
author: Christopher Nolan

quote: Never in my wildest dreams did I entertain the idea that I would become a fashion designer.
author: Giorgio Armani

quote: I might be writing what people expect me to write, writing from that place where I might be ruled by economic considerations. To overcome that, I started working with my dreams, because I'm not so censored when I use dream material.
author: Kathy Acker

quote: I envy people with dreams and passions, but I don't think that way. I still don't have a 'bliss' to follow. For people like me - I suspect that's most people - holding out for a 'dream' or a 'passion' is paralyzing. I just like having work I enjoy that feels meaningful. That's hard enough... but it's enough.
author: Jane Pauley

quote: Saddle your dreams before you ride em.
author: Mary Webb

quote: Genius is an African who dreams up snow.
author: Vladimir Nabokov

quote: Acting is also working with people who invite you into their dreams and trust you with their innermost being.
author: Catherine Deneuve

quote: So many financial dreams are thwarted by the failure to act upon good intentions.
author: Suze Orman

quote: I was not looking for my dreams to interpret my life, but rather for my life to interpret my dreams.
author: Susan Sontag

quote: We use our parents like recurring dreams, to be entered into when needed.
author: Doris Lessing

quote: Dreams get you into the future and add excitement to the present.
author: Robert Conklin

quote: I've woken up from dreams and the whole song is there. I'm listening to it in my dreams. I consciously have to wake myself up and get a tape recorder because I hear it like a record.
author: Lenny Kravitz

quote: As I live and am a man, this is an unexaggerated tale - my dreams become the substances of my life.
author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quote: I think when you move past your fear and you go after your dreams wholeheartedly, you become free.
author: LL Cool J

quote: If you're the type of person who has to fulfill your dreams, you've gotta be resourceful to make sure you can do it. I came out to California when I was 21, thinking my New York credentials would take me all the way. I came back home a year later all dejected and a failure.
author: Vin Diesel

quote: I've said it before, but it's absolutely true: My mother gave me my drive, but my father gave me my dreams. Thanks to him, I could see a future.
author: Liza Minnelli

quote: Hold fast to dreams For when dreams go Life is a barren field Frozen with snow.
author: Langston Hughes

quote: We must not let our passions destroy our dreams.
author: Thomas S. Monson

quote: I mean, I'm 48 years old and I've been through a lot in my life - you know, loss, whether it be death, illness, separation. I mean, the failed expectations... We all have dreams.
author: Annie Lennox

quote: My life turned out to be beyond my greatest dreams.
author: Anthony Hopkins

quote: My mother taught me that we all have the power to achieve our dreams. What I lacked was the courage.
author: Clay Aiken

quote: Dreams come true without that possibility, nature would not incite us to have them.
author: John Updike

quote: People ask how can a Jewish kid from the Bronx do preppy clothes? Does it have to do with class and money? It has to do with dreams.
author: Ralph Lauren

quote: Death is the mother of Beauty hence from her, alone, shall come fulfillment to our dreams and our desires.
author: Wallace Stevens

quote: Our politics are our deepest form of expression: they mirror our past experiences and reflect our dreams and aspirations for the future.
author: Paul Wellstone

quote: Our dreams are firsthand creations, rather than residues of waking life. We have the capacity for infinite creativity at least while dreaming, we partake of the power of the Spirit, the infinite Godhead that creates the cosmos.
author: Jackie Gleason

quote: Dreams do come true, even for someone who couldn't speak English and never had a music lesson or much of an education.
author: Lawrence Welk

quote: It is exactly because we are a city that embraces freedom, that welcomes everyone and encourages their dreams, that New York remains on the front lines in the war on terror.
author: Michael Bloomberg

quote: Ironically, it is exactly because we are a city that embraces freedom, that welcomes everyone and encourages their dreams, that New York remains on the front lines in the war on terror.
author: Michael Bloomberg

quote: Believe it or not, lots of people change their majors and abandon their dreams just to avoid a couple of math classes in college.
author: Danica McKellar

quote: Of all our dreams today there is none more important - or so hard to realise - than that of peace in the world. May we never lose our faith in it or our resolve to do everything that can be done to convert it one day into reality.
author: Lester B. Pearson

quote: It has been my observation that parents kill more dreams than anybody.
author: Spike Lee

quote: Sigmund Freud said we act out our own dreams, but if you are only an actor you are not acting out your own dream. You are simply participating in someone else's dream.
author: John Malkovich

quote: I have those dreams that you can't put into words.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: I worked on my voice for Sweet Dreams, but only to match my speaking voice to Patsy's actual singing voice. That was my way into that character.
author: Jessica Lange

quote: I'm very comfortable with the nature of life and death, and that we come to an end. What's most difficult to imagine is that those dreams and early yearnings and desires of childhood and adolescence will also disappear. But who knows? Maybe you become part of the eternal whatever.
author: Hugh Hefner

quote: Dreams are the seeds of change. Nothing ever grows without a seed, and nothing ever changes without a dream.
author: Debby Boone

quote: My dreams have become puny with the reality my life has become.
author: Imelda Marcos

quote: My dreams were always small and puny. All I ever needed was a little house with a little picket fence by the sea. Little did I know that I would live in Malacanang Palace for 20 years and visit all the major palaces of mankind. And then also meet ordinary citizens and the leaders of superpowers.
author: Imelda Marcos

quote: I've had dreams about tricks.
author: Shaun White

quote: Worse than not realizing the dreams of your youth, would be to have been young and never dreamed at all.
author: Jean Genet

quote: My life has been a continuous fulfillment of dreams. It appears that everything I saw and did has a new, and perhaps, more significant meaning, every time I see it. The earth is good. It is a privilege to live thereon.
author: Liberty Hyde Bailey

quote: Literature for me isn't a workaday job, but something which involves desires, dreams and fantasy.
author: Antonio Tabucchi

quote: I love watching people's dreams come true.
author: Jessica Simpson

quote: And our dreams are who we are.
author: Barbara Sher

quote: You can't break my spirit, it's my dreams you take.
author: James Blunt

quote: Big dreams create the magic that stir men's souls to greatness.
author: Bill McCartney

quote: I don't like dreams or reality. I like when dreams become reality because that is my life.
author: Jean Paul Gaultier

quote: My office is at Yankee stadium. Yes, dreams do come true.
author: Derek Jeter

quote: I believe history will come to view 9/11 as an event on par with November 22, 1963, the date on which John F. Kennedy was murdered, cutting short a presidency that was growing ever more promising. Dreams died that day in Dallas it is easy to imagine the 1960s turning out rather differently had President Kennedy lived.
author: Jon Meacham

quote: You control your future, your destiny. What you think about comes about. By recording your dreams and goals on paper, you set in motion the process of becoming the person you most want to be. Put your future in good hands - your own.
author: Mark Victor Hansen

quote: Only in dreams, in poetry, in play do we sometimes arrive at what we were before we were this thing that, who knows, we are.
author: Julio Cortazar

quote: From time immemorial artistic insights have been revealed to artists in their sleep and in dreams, so that at all times they ardently desired them.
author: Paracelsus

quote: Field of Dreams is probably our generation's It's A Wonderful Life.
author: Kevin Costner

quote: I'm a big fan of dreams. Unfortunately, dreams are our first casualty in life - people seem to give them up, quicker than anything, for a 'reality.'
author: Kevin Costner

quote: Instead of plotting the demise of the traditional family, as some politicians and religious leaders would have you believe, gay people mow their lawns and watch 'American Idol' and video their children's concerts and have the same hopes and dreams that their straight counterparts do.
author: Jodi Picoult

quote: Like all young reporters - brilliant or hopelessly incompetent - I dreamed of the glamorous life of the foreign correspondent: prowling Vienna in a Burberry trench coat, speaking a dozen languages to dangerous women, narrowly escaping Sardinian bandits - the usual stuff that newspaper dreams are made of.
author: Russell Baker

quote: People's dreams are made out of what they do all day. The same way a dog that runs after rabbits will dream of rabbits. It's what you do that makes your soul, not the other way around.
author: Barbara Kingsolver

quote: As a young man you don't notice at all that you were, after all, badly affected. For years afterwards, at least ten years, I kept getting these dreams, in which I had to crawl through ruined houses, along passages I could hardly get through.
author: Otto Dix

quote: Love is the most terrible, and also the most generous of the passions it is the only one which includes in its dreams the happiness of someone else.
author: Alphonse Karr

quote: I'm living out my dreams and I love what I do.
author: Ashley Tisdale

quote: I paint what cannot be photographed, that which comes from the imagination or from dreams, or from an unconscious drive.
author: Man Ray

quote: Today, I'm very happy about myself, because I realized my dreams. I learned how to understand what people want.
author: Roberto Cavalli

quote: Within our dreams and aspirations we find our opportunities.
author: Sugar Ray Leonard

quote: Dream the impossible because dreams do come true.
author: Elijah Wood

quote: The American Dream has run out of gas. The car has stopped. It no longer supplies the world with its images, its dreams, its fantasies. No more. It's over. It supplies the world with its nightmares now: the Kennedy assassination, Watergate, Vietnam.
author: J. G. Ballard

quote: We've removed the ceiling above our dreams. There are no more impossible dreams.
author: Jesse Jackson

quote: Women are not in love with me but with the picture of me on the screen. I am merely the canvas on which women paint their dreams.
author: Rudolph Valentino

quote: Dreams become reality when we put our minds to it.
author: Queen Latifah

quote: The readers are the ones who let us live our dreams. I try to write books which are really compelling - that you'd take on vacation and rather than going out, you'd read in your hotel room because you had to find out what happened. Hopefully that's what readers are responding to.
author: Harlan Coben

quote: Men don't come up to you to just talk. We come up to you with a plan. We're looking across the room at you, and we don't care about your hopes and dreams. We don't care about what your future holds. We saw something we wanted.
author: Steve Harvey

quote: It's not like I don't have my own wants and dreams anymore - it's just that the kids come first. It's primal.
author: Angie Harmon

quote: One day it just hit me. This is it. You are not in love. So either stay in it because you have a child or be brave and find the man of your dreams and marry him for real.
author: Brandy Norwood

quote: Dreams are where we visit the many lands and landscapes of human possibility and discover the one where we feel at home. The great religious leaders were all dreamers.
author: Jonathan Sacks

quote: Dreaming in public is an important part of our job description, as science writers, but there are bad dreams as well as good dreams. We're dreamers, you see, but we're also realists, of a sort.
author: William Gibson

quote: As you look back at your life, there are just a million different things that have happened, just in the right way, to allow you to make your dreams come true. And you know, someone has all that under control.
author: Michael P. Anderson

quote: In a couple, sometimes, one or both people have to give up their personal life, dreams and ambitions for the good of the family.
author: Monica Bellucci

quote: Men never cling to their dreams with such tenacity as at the moment when they are losing faith in them, and know it, but do not dare yet to confess it to themselves.
author: William Graham Sumner

quote: Take what you can from your dreams, make them as real as anything.
author: Dave Matthews

quote: I am consumed with the fear of failing. Reaching deep down and finding confidence has made all my dreams come true.
author: Arsenio Hall

quote: What better model of a synthesis than a nocturnal dream? Dreams simplify, don't they?
author: Manuel Puig

quote: After having done this whole slew of press for 'Big Love,' now I'll have anxiety dreams for like a week and a half about all the stupid things I said. I can't even imagine being in front of the cameras all the time. I had a weird dream the other night that I was on 'Jersey Shore.'
author: Chloe Sevigny

quote: Even having to do the amount of press that I have to do is dreadful and gives me so much anxiety. After having done this whole slew of press for 'Big Love,' now I'll have anxiety dreams for like a week and a half about all the stupid things I said.
author: Chloe Sevigny

quote: When we are motivated by goals that have deep meaning, by dreams that need completion, by pure love that needs expressing, then we truly live.
author: Greg Anderson

quote: The permanent temptation of life is to confuse dreams with reality. The permanent defeat of life comes when dreams are surrendered to reality.
author: James A. Michener

quote: Everyone wants to look their best, everyone has dreams of wanting to look like something else. But we are who we are.
author: Samantha Morton

quote: Prime Minister Sharon, Prime Minister Abbas, I urge you today to end the designs of those who seek destruction, annihilation and occupation, and I urge you to have the will and the courage to begin to realize our dreams of peace, prosperity and coexistence.
author: King Abdullah II

quote: I'm not certain, but I have a little gypsy blood in me. And my mother always told me that her grandma could give someone the evil eye, and I'd better not cross her because she had some of that blood in her. Mother always believed that she could predict the future, and she had dreams that came true.
author: Sam Raimi

quote: The atmosphere is much too near for dreams. It forces us to action. It is close to us. We are in it and of it. It rouses us both to study and to do. We must know its moods and also its motive forces.
author: Cleveland Abbe

quote: You know, one of my biggest dreams in life is to play a Disney princess.
author: Ginnifer Goodwin

quote: When I look back over my life it's almost as if there was a plan laid out for me - from the little girl who was so passionate about animals who longed to go to Africa and whose family couldn't afford to put her through college. Everyone laughed at my dreams. I was supposed to be a secretary in Bournemouth.
author: Jane Goodall

quote: Always wear cute pyjamas to bed, you'll never know who u will meet in your dreams.
author: Joel Madden

quote: A player dreams of being a superstar, but he doesn't want people flocking all over him asking for an autograph.
author: Dennis Rodman

quote: They should invent some way to tape-record your dreams. I've written songs in my dreams that were Beatles songs. Then I'd wake up and they'd be gone.
author: Alice Cooper

quote: The Columbia is lost, but the dreams that inspired its crew remain with us.
author: Dick Cheney

quote: Cherish your visions and your dreams, as they are the children of your soul the blueprints of your ultimate achievements.
author: Napolean Hill

quote: Never set limits, go after your dreams, don't be afraid to push the boundaries. And laugh a lot - it's good for you!
author: Paula Radcliffe

quote: I want to help children in Serbia and around the world so they can realize their dreams.
author: Novak Djokovic

quote: Those born into poverty or on the margins of society require our extra support to realize their dreams.
author: Novak Djokovic

quote: I know it sounds corny, but when you follow your dreams, it happens. And if it's music, take it seriously.
author: Enrique Iglesias

quote: There's a lot of blood, sweat, and guts between dreams and success.
author: Paul Bryant

quote: You have the dreams that you want, and then you have to do other jobs until you can get to that dream.
author: Channing Tatum

quote: I save my dreams and hopes for my kids. When I'm making a wish under a bridge or tunnel, it's always for them.
author: Alison Sweeney

quote: If I thought that any of this was pre ordained, then it takes away any kind of incentive to struggle, or to put up with things, to reach for those impossible dreams, all those dramatic things.
author: Gary Numan

quote: When violence becomes imbedded in a region, then this affects everything. It affects your dreams, your fantasies and relationships, and your religion becomes violent, too.
author: Karen Armstrong

quote: There's a line I have that our family was designed more for public than for private. But there are definitely some things that are only mine. I am someone who dreams at night, and you don't know what I'm dreaming.
author: Carrie Fisher

quote: My father, his spirit is with me constantly, and I'm a believer in that world and the world of dreams and that stuff.
author: Ziggy Marley

quote: I've never been bashful to say that I'm not really interested in Formula One. When I lived in England, it's all I wanted to do and I thought that anything else would somehow be a compromise to my dreams. But then when I came back to the States, I realised how much I loved being back in the States.
author: Danica Patrick

quote: I've been interested in dreams since I as a kid and I've wanted to do a film about them for a long time.
author: Christopher Nolan

quote: But I have been interested in dreams, really since I was a kid. I have always been fascinated by the idea that your mind, when you are asleep, can create a world in a dream and you are perceiving it as though it really existed.
author: Christopher Nolan

quote: The buildings that I build very often have a dreamlike reality. I don't mean by that they have a fantasy quality at all, in fact quite the reverse. They contain in some degree the ingredients that give dreams their power... stuff that's very close to us.
author: Christopher Alexander

quote: Freedom is not an ideal, it is not even a protection, if it means nothing more than freedom to stagnate, to live without dreams, to have no greater aim than a second car and another television set.
author: Adlai Stevenson

quote: I think cinema is closer to allegories than to reality. It's closer to our dreams.
author: Manuel Puig

quote: There is hope in dreams, imagination, and in the courage of those who wish to make those dreams a reality.
author: Jonas Salk

quote: In my wildest dreams, I could not have imagined a sweeter life.
author: Hugh Hefner

quote: Vain hopes are like certain dreams of those who wake.
author: Quintilian

quote: My professional dreams were coming true while I was living a personal nightmare.
author: Dane Cook

quote: My dreams are all follies.
author: Taylor Caldwell

quote: Dreams have always expanded our understanding of reality by challenging our boundaries of the real, of the possible.
author: Henry Reed

quote: It has never been my object to record my dreams, just the determination to realize them.
author: Man Ray

quote: We used to talk about wanting to get some money, but that's when hip-hop was based on your dreams and your fantasy. The whole thing now is the dreams and fantasies were achieved, and you don't want to make it the focal point. You can't keep beating that dead horse.
author: Puff Daddy

quote: My mother was always working for a job, so I guess I was always trained that I should have multiple jobs, multiple aspirations. And I remember she had multiple aspirations, always hearing about her dreams and things she did in the past and things she wanted to do.
author: Puff Daddy

quote: Good dreams don't come cheap, you've got to pay for them and If you just dream when you're asleep this is no way for them to come alive... to survive.
author: Harry Chapin

quote: I was always someone who lived in the future all the time, it was always the next thing - dreams of escape.
author: Julie Walters

quote: There's a good deal in common between the mind's eye and the TV screen, and though the TV set has all too often been the boobtube, it could be, it can be, the box of dreams.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quote: You'll be much more successful if you follow your dreams and follow your passions.
author: Jay Weatherill

quote: Google is a global Rorschach test. We see in it what we want to see. Google has built an infrastructure that makes a lot of dreams closer to reality.
author: John Battelle

quote: Dreams do come true. If anyone's proof of that, it's me.
author: Jennifer Hudson

quote: Things have gone beyond my wildest expectations and dreams, and I feel like I've been given so many blessings in my life, between my friendship with the guys in the band, our wonderful audience, being able to play this music, and then my family.
author: Trey Anastasio

quote: My dreams and aspirations when I was a child for as long as I can remember was to be an entertainer.
author: Brittany Murphy

quote: My mother gave me my drive but my father gave me my dreams.
author: Liza Minnelli

quote: Having achieved my own dreams, I want to give to kids who are less fortunate, who struggle with everyday obstacles. I want to give them something positive in their lives: support.
author: Kristi Yamaguchi

quote: You have to dream dreams to live dreams.
author: Eric Lindros

quote: But baseball bounced back in the next decade to reclaim its place as the national pastime: new heroes, spirited competition, and booming prosperity gave birth to dreams of expansion, both within the major leagues and around the world.
author: John Thorn

quote: I'd really like to get the girl, shoot the gun, drive the car, have fun. I even have these kind of action dreams, where I'm the action guy.
author: Kevin Bacon

quote: Sometimes, you follow your dreams. I say to the young people, 'If you have a dream, chase it.'
author: Karl Malone

quote: It was never in my dreams to make my personal life anybody else's business.
author: Ethan Hawke

quote: No person has the right to rain on your dreams.
author: Marian Wright Edelman

quote: I am rich beyond the dreams of avarice.
author: Edward Moore

quote: I led the life of an intellectual up until a certain age. I remember Freud's 'Interpretation of Dreams' was a big favorite when I was 11. It sounded so interesting. And it really was!
author: Wallace Shawn

quote: I have shared my whole life. My private and my show business life. It helps me actually to feel my songs and to go on with my dreams.
author: Celine Dion

quote: I'm particularly proud of my reluctance to share my dreams with anyone.
author: Todd Barry

quote: Talking, talking. Spinning a web of words, pale walls of dreams, between myself and all I see.
author: John Gardner

quote: In Nicaragua, liberty, equality and the rule of law were the stuff of dreams. But in Paris I discovered the value of those words.
author: Bianca Jagger

quote: So many of my dreams were to actually be able to make a living of what I did as a hobby.
author: Rick Baker

quote: As a child our dreams got scattered all about and all our future prospects got scattered to so many places, and we spend our lives trying to find the little pieces that make up our lives and make up the dreams that we had as a child that got blown away in the windstorm.
author: Terrence Howard

quote: I work, and then whenever I have any other time, I'm with my daughter, and then I go to sleep. I think you basically have to abandon the dreams of having any other adult activities in your life. You have to go to sleep whenever your child goes to sleep. That's basically how we're doing it.
author: Tina Fey

quote: We live because of the dreams.
author: Marat Safin

quote: The usual channels of university studies or secretarial work did not appeal to me. I cherished difficult dreams through confidence in myself.
author: Ella Maillart

quote: If dreams are like movies, then memories are films about ghosts.
author: Adam Duritz

quote: With Shakespeare and poetry, a new world was born. New dreams, new desires, a self consciousness was born. I desired to know to know myself in terms of the new standards set by these books.
author: Peter Abrahams

quote: The Brown decision promised that every child, regardless of the color of his or her skin, would have unequivocal access to quality education and an equal opportunity to pursue his/her dreams.
author: Ed Markey

quote: Technology has a great advantage in that we are capable of creating dinosaurs and show them on the screen even though they are extinct 65 million years. All of a sudden, we have a fantastic tool that is as good as dreams are.
author: Werner Herzog

quote: I mean, we've all had those dreams where, you know, we try to cry out and our voice won't come.
author: Tom Hooper

quote: We all have our time machines. Some take us back, they're called memories. Some take us forward, they're called dreams.
author: Jeremy Irons

quote: Dreams are illusions, and we can't let go of them because we would be dead.
author: David Copperfield

quote: I try to help people realize their dreams by using magic to tell stories that educate, move, and inspire.
author: David Copperfield

quote: What differentiates us from animals is the fact that we can listen to other people's dreams, fears, joys, sorrows, desires and defeats - and they in turn can listen to ours.
author: Henning Mankell

quote: Most 'reality' shows aren't reality at all. They're game shows with no prize. Like 'Rock of Love.' His aren't genuine feelings. Then again, Bob Barker didn't really care whether or not you won the toaster. Sorry to shatter everyone's dreams.
author: Hal Sparks

quote: Whoever I can go out every week and motivate to do better and to try to go after their dreams, I'm up for that.
author: Robert Griffin III

quote: The work of an advertising agency is warmly and immediately human. It deals with human needs, wants, dreams and hopes. Its 'product' cannot be turned out on an assembly line.
author: Leo Burnett

quote: I think people tend to see the bigger point, which is maybe not fitting in and feeling like you didn't have the childhood that you expected you would have, or that you felt lonely or struggled with drugs and alcohol or just that you were able to achieve your dreams.
author: Augusten Burroughs

quote: When I was a kid, I wanted to be serious, like Daniel Day-Lewis. No one really dreams of being a comic actor, do they? Now I realise how stupid that is - and it's because comic acting isn't taken seriously enough. It's a discipline. You know instantly - either you're funny and getting the laughs, or you're not.
author: Chris O'Dowd

quote: Too many athletes are living in a tiny window. They have no vision for themselves - what they can be outside of football and what they can mean to a community. They just don't know any better. My hopes and dreams are unlimited.
author: Junior Seau

quote: The human imagination... has great difficulty in living strictly within the confines of a materialist practice or philosophy. It dreams, like a dog in its basket, of hares in the open.
author: John Berger

quote: I have absurdly vivid dreams.
author: Erin Morgenstern

quote: I mean, every child at one stage dreams of being a prince or a princess.
author: Mary, Crown Princess of Denmark

quote: I don't understand people who dream in black and white. I just don't get it. My dreams have always been vivid color.
author: Gary Ross

quote: We have lost that which has made us great over the generations, and that is the sense of individual and personal responsibility that we can come up, we can pursue our dreams and our aspirations and we won't be blocked by government regulation, by the inability to get a loan as a small business to make our dreams come true.
author: Jon Huntsman, Jr.

quote: Dreams seem to have a will of their own.
author: Henry Reed

quote: I published in 1978 a report on dreams in the Journal of Clinical Psychology. It was the first study of its kind to demonstrate that it is possible for people to make constructive use of their dreams to improve their lives.
author: Henry Reed

quote: I think everyone dreams of that nice romantic wedding.
author: Lance Bass

quote: I was not born in a home where there were stereotypes. So that was very useful because it gave me the sense of possibilities, of flying, if I may say, of making my hopes and dreams a reality.
author: Michelle Bachelet

quote: I've never dreamed of a story idea. I have such boring dreams.
author: R. L. Stine

quote: Our dreams are made of real things, like a shoebox full of photographs.
author: Jack Johnson

quote: I have a notebook that is filled to the brim with my dreams and ideas and goals and aspirations.
author: Karlie Kloss

quote: My dreams came true while wearing the opening look from the spring/summer 2010 Dior ready-to-wear collection. I will never forget how special I felt opening John Galliano's show, like I was living a dream.
author: Karlie Kloss

quote: Sometimes your dreams come true.
author: Frank Bruno

quote: Catcher in the Rye had a profound impact on me-the idea that we all have lots of dreams that are slowly being chipped away as we grow up.
author: Judd Nelson

quote: Though I know he loves me, tonight my heart is sad his kiss was not so wonderful as all the dreams I had.
author: Sara Teasdale

quote: I am very lucky because I am realizing my childhood dreams, and after presenting my shows it's like a party.
author: Jean Paul Gaultier

quote: That disturbs people when they know they didn't have the guts or integrity to stick to their dreams.
author: Sandra Bernhard

quote: My heroes, my dreams, and my future lay in Yankee Stadium. And they can't take that away from me.
author: Derek Jeter

quote: I only remember the end of my dreams, like waking up at a steering wheel, or falling.
author: Ben Barnes

quote: Talking about food is like talking about your dreams. Everyone has something to say. We all have to eat, it's just what we eat which differs. Some people eat for fuel and I feel bad for them.
author: Gael Garcia Bernal

quote: I tell people, 'It's just like a cliche, but it's true: In Hollywood, dreams can come true.'
author: Michael Clarke Duncan

quote: I married the man of my dreams in 1998.
author: Cindy Margolis

quote: But we can hold our spirits and our bodies so pure and high, we may cherish such thoughts and such ideals, and dream such dreams of lofty purpose, that we can determine and know what manner of men we will be, whenever and wherever the hour strikes and calls to noble action.
author: Joshua Chamberlain

quote: I part of this great nation because my grandfather was born here, in Cincinnati, Ohio. He took a horse, back in 1895, and ride it all the way down to Guanajuato, looking for his American dream. No penny in his pocket, only dreams in his head. And he was an immigrant coming from the States into Mexico. And he found his American dream in Mexico.
author: Vicente Fox

quote: We need to be aware of what we are capable of first and realize that if you place your dreams really really high, you do have the potential to get to that level.
author: Vicente Fox

quote: Sports nurtures dreams of achieving self confidence and masculine striving for the skinny kid watching a boxer dance around the ring with sublime ease.
author: Armstrong Williams

quote: People's real hopes and dreams can be distorted and misdirected and packaged until you're not sure what you really want or what you even really need.
author: Tracy Chapman

quote: When I began to choreograph and find my way pulling other artists' dreams out and changing music in a visual way, there was still a part of me that had something more to say.
